svg.aria-label: Choropleth map of India for 2026Q2, showing each state's merchant transactions as a share of its own transactions against the national 63.9%. Delhi is highest at 68.5% and West Bengal lowest at 56.4% among the 17 states above one percent of national volume. All 36 states and union territories are shown, with seven small territories given numbered markers and a key.

svg.text: Delhi runs on merchants, West Bengal runs on transfers
Each state's merchant transactions as a share of its own, 2026Q2. All 36 states and union territories, with the seven too small to see given numbered markers and a key.
Source: PhonePe Pulse per-state category files, 2026Q2. Measured, not derived from ticket size. Boundaries built by site/scripts/build_india_map.py. Computed by
MERCHANT SHARE OF A STATE'S OWN TRANSACTIONS
India is at 63.9%. Colour is distance from that.
